title: Puuchanikkaai Pookova and Urulaikkilongku Karai, Parripu daal and special rice

items.name: Puuchanikkaai Pookova and Urulaikkilongku Karai
items.description: Butternut squash, cauliflower, pepper and potato curry

items.name: Special Rice
items.description: Yellow basmati rice with mild spices

ingredients:
Puuchanikkaai Pookova and Urulaikkilongku Karai

butternut squash, mixed pepper, cauliflower, red potatoes, vegetable oil, brown onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, bay leaves, cinnamon, roasted curry powder (red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, fennel, fenugreek, turmeric, black pepper, clove, cinnamon, curry leaves, rampe leaves (Pandan)), fresh coriander, Mustard Seeds, fresh curry leaves, turmeric, tamarind, cumin seeds, salt, tomato ketchup ((Spirit Vinegar, Sugar, Salt, Spice and Herb Extracts (contain Celery), Spice).

Parripu daal

red split lentils, vegetable oil, brown onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, coconut milk (coconut extract, water, Guar Gum) Mustard Seeds, fresh curry leaves, turmeric, cumin seeds, dried chili flakes, garlic, fresh green chili, salt.

Special rice

Basmati rice, vegetable oil, black cardamom, salt, garlic, ginger, bay leaves, cinnamon.

ALLERGY INFORMATION: CONTAINS MUSTARD SEEDS and CELERY
